info.headline: Notify NYC - Planned Natural Gas Work
info.description:
Notification issued 10-02-2026 at 03:00 PM.
National Grid is scheduled to conduct planned natural gas work tomorrow, 10/3, which may result in an odor of natural gas near 235th Street between 121st Avenue and 128th Avenue in Queens. The work is scheduled to take place between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM. Please report natural gas emergencies to 9-1-1 if they occur.
